payload.claim: The acceptance set requires an unusually large combinatorial witness for criterion 1 (all 120 orders of five parents, in both modes, plus two more arrangements, inside one test), five more new or rewritten tests, and five rewritten existing tests and fixtures, on top of production changes threading one new shared helper through three modules; a person should weigh whether budget_usd: 52 and max_turns: 220 give enough headroom given comparable precedents (SA-0267's $30/150, SA-0290's $50/190) had far simpler witness demands, since mutation and wrong-version probing re-runs these same heavy witnesses repeatedly during REVIEW.
